name: gamedev-physics
description: Use when working with a game engine's physics — rigid bodies, colliders, collision layers and masks, character controllers, joints, forces versus impulses, raycasts and shapecasts, or when a simulation is unstable (tunnelling, jitter, missed overlaps). Covers the Godot, Unity and Unreal equivalents. NOT rendering or shader-driven visual jitter (that is `gamedev-shaders`), NOT navigation, pathfinding or navmesh (that is `gamedev-pathing`).
